fields: [pic=1]*She turns to you with a heartfelt look*
[pic=3]Ok, looks like she wants to get started as soon as possible.
I can just watch if it’s not weird for them.
[pic=4]I’ve never seen this before! The others are gonna love you!
Great! Buuut… if it’s an orgy… and like…
You said you didn’t want your mom and me…
[pic=3]Oh, no worries! She won’t be there.
[pic=5]Yeah, it’s our job during these rituals. As Matriarch, she does a lot of chanting and me and a few other mice are there to assist however.
[pic=4]Don’t worry about me though, I’ve been on the fun side of these a ton.
[pic=1]Yeah. <pause>The markings these mice have are symbolic. And all of the participants must have these markings.
Oh! I was going to ask you about those…
[pic=1]Yeah I’ll fill ya in later. We have to get started though, and they will need some time to paint you.
[pic=3]I’ll have some mice help you, till then, can you drop off the jar by that stump?
